notes: ADR-2026-09-24-gliner2-required: GLiNER2 is the FIRST model invoked for natural-language requests (after the deterministic grammar parser). Bonsai is fallback only when GLiNER2 path is incomplete AND the request clearly requires contextual reasoning.

Implementation: Python sidecar `hearth-extract`. The hearth-control service calls it over a local HTTP/Unix socket. The sidecar ships with the installer (plan section 11) and has its own pinning lock.
Authority separation: GLiNER2 proposes meaning. The resolver (in hearth-control) owns actor identity, permissions, target scope, evidence. Same constraint as Bonsai (plan section 7).
Failure isolation: if GLiNER2 is unavailable, direct controls + saved routines still work; only the natural-language Ask surface degrades. Same as Bonsai unavailability.
No cloud inference. The Apache-2.0 licensed checkpoint downloads at install time; no telemetry; no remote calls. CPU-first per upstream README.
When upgrading this lock, re-run Stage 0/3 gate (eval suite must hold the metric_targets above).
